server.name: app-review-intel-mcp
server.instructions: App review intelligence for the Apple App Store and Google Play (no API keys). Typical flow: search_apps to get an app id → review_insights for a one-call summary (ratings, complaints, what got worse in the latest version) → get_app_reviews only when you need raw review text → compare_apps for competitor benchmarks. Apple ids are numeric (284882215); Google Play ids are package names (com.instagram.android); the store is inferred from the id. Review data is a recent sample (≤500 reviews per country per call), not the full rating population.

tools.name: search_apps
tools.title: Search apps (App Store / Google Play)
tools.description: Find apps by name or keyword and get the app id the other tools need. Returns id (Apple numeric id or Google Play package name), name, developer, rating, rating count, price, genre, current version, store URL (Google adds installs). Use when the user names an app ("Duolingo", "Calm") or a category ("budget apps"). Set store: "google" for Android/Google Play. Cheap, one call. Next: review_insights or compare_apps.

term.description: App name or keywords, e.g. "notion" or "habit tracker".

lang.description: Google Play only: review/listing language, e.g. "en", "de", "pt-BR". Default "en". Ignored for Apple.

tools.name: get_app_reviews
tools.title: Get raw app reviews
tools.description: Fetch raw reviews for one app: rating, title (Apple only), text, app version, date, helpful votes (Google adds developer replies). Use when the user wants to read or quote actual reviews or you need text for custom analysis. For summaries, complaints or "what broke", call review_insights instead: it is one flat-priced call. Billed per review returned (~50 per page; default 1 page). Max 10 pages ≈ 500 reviews.

app_id.description: App to analyse. Apple: numeric id (284882215), "id284882215" or an apps.apple.com URL. Google Play: package name (com.instagram.android) or a play.google.com URL. Get ids from search_apps.

store.description: "apple" (App Store) or "google" (Google Play). Optional: inferred from app_id (numeric → apple, package name → google).

lang.description: Google Play only: review/listing language, e.g. "en", "de", "pt-BR". Default "en". Ignored for Apple.

pages.description: Review pages to fetch, ~50 newest reviews each (1-10). Default 1.

tools.name: review_insights
tools.title: Review insights & what got worse
tools.description: Best first call for any question about an app's user feedback. Analyses recent reviews and returns: rating distribution, average rating per app version, top complaint phrases from 1-2★ reviews (share + example quote), versionDeltas (latest version vs earlier: rating change, negative-share change, rising complaints with quotes; falls back to last 3 days vs earlier), and sample quotes. Use for "why are users unhappy with X", "what broke in the last update", "top complaints about X", "summarize feedback". One flat price per call regardless of pages/countries. For the review text itself use get_app_reviews; to benchmark several apps at once use compare_apps. Apple and Google Play.

app_id.description: App to analyse. Apple: numeric id (284882215), "id284882215" or an apps.apple.com URL. Google Play: package name (com.instagram.android) or a play.google.com URL. Get ids from search_apps.

store.description: "apple" (App Store) or "google" (Google Play). Optional: inferred from app_id (numeric → apple, package name → google).

lang.description: Google Play only: review/listing language, e.g. "en", "de", "pt-BR". Default "en". Ignored for Apple.

countries.description: Storefronts to pool, e.g. ["us","gb","ca"]. Default ["us"]. More countries = bigger sample.

pages.description: Review pages to fetch, ~50 newest reviews each (1-10). Default 3.

since_version.description: Optional: compare reviews on this version and newer against older versions (e.g. "450.0.0"). Default: newest version in the sample vs earlier ones.

tools.name: compare_apps
tools.title: Compare apps side by side
tools.description: Benchmark 2-10 apps in one storefront for competitor analysis: store rating, rating count, price, current version & release date (Google adds installs), plus recent-review metrics (sample average, % negative / positive, latest-version average, top 5 complaints) and per-metric leaders. Apple ids and Google Play package names can be mixed (e.g. iOS vs Android of the same app). Examples: "Notion vs Evernote", "which meditation app has the happiest users". One flat price per call. Get ids from search_apps first. For one app in depth (version deltas, more quotes) use review_insights instead.

items.description: App to analyse. Apple: numeric id (284882215), "id284882215" or an apps.apple.com URL. Google Play: package name (com.instagram.android) or a play.google.com URL. Get ids from search_apps.

lang.description: Google Play only: review/listing language, e.g. "en", "de", "pt-BR". Default "en". Ignored for Apple.

pages.description: Review pages to fetch, ~50 newest reviews each (1-10). Default 2.

reviews.author: Jo Oxley Stroback
reviews.title: How Facebook brings like-minded people together in a forum for learning purposes.
reviews.body:
I am fortunate enough to have a lifestyle that allows me to pretty much do whatever I wanna do every day and go where I wanna go and speak to whoever I wanna meet! How much better than that does life get and I’ve met the most amazing people everywhere I’ve traveled in the world! Facebook over any other application has been the one venue that it has been easy to stay connected to people that you just met whether they are located near or far to you home location. I am lucky enough to have two home locations, one in magical Sarasota, Florida and the other in absolutely gorgeous Castelnuovo Cilento, Italy (in the Province of Salerno, Region of Campania) which is the long way of saying two hours south of Napoli or 1.5 hours south of the Amalfi Coast. Facebook has become. THE TOOL OF CHOICE that I use to stay in contact with my friends, no matter where in the world they are. While I have been lucky enough to do a bit of travel traveling, I am not nearly done with that aspect of my life. I’m just beginning. To date, I have traveled as far as Dubai for a Florida Real Estate trade mission along with other personal travel I have done in Europe (Ireland, Portugal, France and in Italy, too many times to mention). Regarding Caribbean islands, I have been to Grand Cayman, Puerto Rico, Honduras, Barbados grand Turk, St. Thomas, St. John and Cozumel. in the United States, I have spent time in over 95 airports and in every state, except Alaska, Hawaii, Montana, Wyoming, Utah, north and south Dakota, Maine, and New Mexico, in my work that took me to visit high volume specialty physicians all over our country to transitioning them from paper medical records to electronic medical records and also e-prescribing.
As I continue to execute on my bucket list while traveling to many other countries where I have not yet been, I will continue to use Facebook as my method of continued connection with all the wonderful people I meet in this great world!!

reviews.title: Takes away your control

reviews.author: Cocotheparrot
reviews.title: Instrusive ads
reviews.body: Overall, I enjoy using the Facebook App. My only issue is the ads have become quite intrusive. Ads are ok, but the intrusiveness takes away from the Facebook user experience.

      "body": "I wouldn’t be writing this review, if I had been capable of talking to actual person! In the middle of the night, while I was asleep, someone succeeded at hacking into one of my Instagram accounts…after only two failed attempts! At the time of the first two attempts, which, again, happened while I was asleep, Instagram sent codes to my phone. On the third attempt, a message was sent to me via WhatsApp, informing me that my account had been accessed. That was just after 2AM. \n\nWhen I discovered these messages, after I woke up, at around 8AM, I clicked on a link that required me to verify whether it was me who had logged in. I, of course, clicked on “This wasn’t me.” Nothing happened! Every time I tried clicking on that option, a message popped up saying, “Something went wrong. Please try again.” It just said that over and over again. I was horrified. I had two Instagram accounts. The one that was hacked into, I simply deleted because I wasn’t using it that much anyway. \n\nThe big problem is, the account that was hacked into was connected to my other, more important account, as well as my Facebook profile. I wonder what information the hacker stole! Lord knows, they had plenty of time to take whatever they wanted! The most I could do was chat with an AI bot about it! I gave this app two stars, instead of one, only because there is plenty about Instagram that I actually like, but what is it worth to have such a social media account when things like this can happen so easily?!",

reviews.author: JJLin283
reviews.title: Questionable security and no human being to talk to about it!
reviews.body:
I wouldn’t be writing this review, if I had been capable of talking to actual person! In the middle of the night, while I was asleep, someone succeeded at hacking into one of my Instagram accounts…after only two failed attempts! At the time of the first two attempts, which, again, happened while I was asleep, Instagram sent codes to my phone. On the third attempt, a message was sent to me via WhatsApp, informing me that my account had been accessed. That was just after 2AM. 

When I discovered these messages, after I woke up, at around 8AM, I clicked on a link that required me to verify whether it was me who had logged in. I, of course, clicked on “This wasn’t me.” Nothing happened! Every time I tried clicking on that option, a message popped up saying, “Something went wrong. Please try again.” It just said that over and over again. I was horrified. I had two Instagram accounts. The one that was hacked into, I simply deleted because I wasn’t using it that much anyway. 

The big problem is, the account that was hacked into was connected to my other, more important account, as well as my Facebook profile. I wonder what information the hacker stole! Lord knows, they had plenty of time to take whatever they wanted! The most I could do was chat with an AI bot about it! I gave this app two stars, instead of one, only because there is plenty about Instagram that I actually like, but what is it worth to have such a social media account when things like this can happen so easily?!

reviews.author: wucls
reviews.title: Creative and User-Enhancing Suggestions
reviews.body: Dear Instagram Developers, I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to offer a few suggestions that I believe would greatly benefit and enhance the functionality of Instagram. Firstly, I propose the inclusion of a feature that would allow users to add music to their profiles. This addition would undoubtedly add a whole new dimension of creativity and personalization, empowering users to express themselves through their favorite tunes. Secondly, I would like to address a concern regarding the white circle that surrounds the profile photo. In my opinion, this visual element can sometimes disrupt the overall aesthetic and proportion of the photo. I respectfully suggest that the option to remove or customize this circle be made available, allowing users to further curate their profiles in alignment with their personal branding. Last but not least, I would like to express my desire for Instagram to support the option of using GIFs as profile photos. This animated form of self-expression would undoubtedly inject a playful and engaging element into users' profiles, increasing their appeal and individuality. I genuinely believe that these proposals could positively impact the Instagram user experience, fostering increased creativity and allowing for further personalization. I appreciate your time and consideration, and I eagerly look forward to seeing the continued evolution of the platform. Thank you for your attention to these suggestions.

reviews.author: Aaron M.W.
reviews.title: Square Grids are an IG Staple
reviews.body: Whats up developers, 13 year IG veteran here. Hope all is well. I have two questions for you. (1.) Would you enforce us to make pancakes without flour if you discovered gluten-free methods were becoming popular? (2.) Would you eradicate the usage of all pens or pencils just because we now have the keyboard? No. I’m sure you wouldn’t. As a matter of fact, I believe you would provide us with the option to decide. The rectangular grid system is uprooting a fundamental element that made IG what it was. Remember back in the day when IG filters came with a SQUARE frame option? In the grand scheme of things, this is obviously a 1st world problem, but in regards to making the decision to keep the rectangular system, I’ve noticed that even you haven’t made your mind up. You’ve changed it back and forth several times, and of my two profiles, sometimes one of them has a square profile grid, and the other has rectangle, and that’s just from me toggling from one to the other in the same minute. I believe a rectangle display works as a fantastic method for displaying IG Reels, but I think we can all agree that squares are a foundational display method. I would suggest maybe adding an option in the settings menu so users, like myself, have the option to display a rectangular or square profile feed at their own discretion. Hope this helps.

It’s frustrating! What’s also frustrating is the fact that NOTHING is in chronological order and it makes me want to throw my phone. I no longer see posts friends make for days on end, sometimes not ever. I have to actually click their profile to see they’ve actually been posting and I hadn’t seen not one of their new posts. Same for comments. Interacting via comments on other people’s IG that may have a lot of followers can be crappy. I can never find the comment I made to go back to it and I don’t get any notifications on who liked it to even be able to find it. Please fix ASAP! Also, it’s been crashing a lot lately when I create a story. Makes me wanna just promote my Snapchat instead. :( 

I’m not sure who handles responses to problems reported, but unless I’m reporting a post it seems like I’ll never get a response on anything else. For you all to have such a big company with major people of influence using your platform, you’d think your customer service would be a little better. I don’t care how many millions of people are using it. Supply and demand! Hire more people or sell it to someone who will staff more people to respond to your loyal users. It’s getting out of hand.

Videos are struggling to load and buffer way more than usual. I’ve tried closing the app and reopening it, going to the post on the account and trying to refresh it, whatever you can think of, and it’s not working.
Also I am not a fan of the new profile layout. I have a couple different accounts and each of them seems to have one of three different layouts and it really bothers me. 
I preferred when it was normal, and you had your post/follower/following count across the top, then the edit profile below that, your account description, stories, and then the post overview/scrolling/tagged photos option across the bottom.
Now on some of my accounts, you have to tap on a post in the overview in order to scroll through your posts, and you can’t see just one post at a time. I don’t like it. If I wanted to scroll through them I would have used the scrolling option. When I tap on a photo in the overview I want to just see that post. There also seems to be a waste of blank space on the profile, which is for stories I’m sure, but I’m not posting stories so it should just collapse down and not waste space on my profile.
I do still love the app, and it’s not like I’m going to stop using it now after all these years, but these are just some new things that have come up and I’m not a fan at all.

It’s also insane, sort of like the Wild West. People can harass you, bully you, say awful things, use slurs & hate speech & not face any repercussions. But even if you follow wholesome things about kittens & puppies, you still run across horrible, selfish, prejudiced, violent people who can get away with saying or doing pretty much whatever they want. If you download it, please don’t get in the habit of reading the comments; I’ve lost a lot of faith in humanity that way.

reviews.author: J🦖B1016
reviews.title: What happened?
reviews.body: I didn’t have any social media until a few years ago, and when I finally decided to do so, Instagram was the first app I downloaded. I love how the app works in allowing us to share posts/pictures and videos, and it’s been great for me to catch up with friends I can’t otherwise spend time with. However, recent updates and changes have made it more challenging to navigate through the app. The one item I am particularly disappointed with is the fact that now, accounts I follow don’t have their posts appearing in chronological order. I can’t be on Instagram all day long because I have responsibilities. I have a life outside of social media. In the past, it was nice because I could check in, and any posts shared would be shown from most recently uploaded posts (unseen by me) to the posts that I had last seen. It was very clear and in chronological order. Now, the setup is more like Facebook. I don’t want the layout to resemble Facebook. I will simply end up seeing the same posts that I’ve seen and liked over and over again, while missing posts from the people I want to stay connected to. I don’t know what has happened, but please change it back. I want to keep using this form of social media, because I would like to stay in touch with my friends. However, if this issue goes unresolved I will get increasingly more annoyed and frustrated. I would very much hate to entertain the thought of stopping my use of Instagram. If you’ve read everything up to this point, I want to thank you for doing so. I would appreciate it all the more so if you were to take my review under consideration. Thank you very much.

reviews.author: Rookie the Rose
reviews.title: Frustrating.
reviews.body: I am a big fan of Instagram it is one of my top apps. I use it daily and nightly, and I love it! You can find people who have similar interests to you and follow people who you like, their is a few downsides that really frustrate me though. Number one being not being able to block full hashtags! Their are hashtags that are really annoying because I keep getting recommended over and over that I wish I could block. Hashtags like “TikTok” are everywhere! Liking one post on the popular hashtag fills my feed with posts related to that, only because it is popular. Adding the feature of blocking posts with a specific hashtag could be very beneficial to users who want to see content they like making it more likely to stay on the app. Secondly is post quality. If your a photographer or an artist or any person who posts material that is bound to have a lot of detail, gets their work downgraded in quality when posted to Instagram. This is a major way of driving people away from the app, and moving to other competing apps to post their content on with much better image quality. Adding to this, cropping posts to a specific ratio is really an annoying feature because you can find yourself working on a creative tasks only for it to be cut off by the cropping feature. Lastly, a limited amount of slides. Why can’t we just have at least fifteen so we can show more in one post? Other than what I listed, the app is full of tremendous amounts of creativity, fun, and lots of amazing people and posts to see!

reviews.author: CK :/
reviews.title: Poorly cropped reels + eliminating a barrier to quickly post particular photos?
reviews.body:
So I purposely format my videos for instagram reels in a 1080 x 1920 resolution and when they are viewed from the main feed, the videos CAN be properly viewed all the way across (meaning all 1080 pixels of content). However, to also view all 1920 pixels of the video’s other dimension, you of course must click on the reel and view it in full screen except this is NOT working out as intended: when in “full screen” mode for reels, the entire 1080 px width of the video is NOT visible for some unknown reason. So, any text that lies near the borders of the video becomes illegible to viewers which is incredibly frustrating to see since I supposedly uploaded the correct size video (9:16 aspect ratio). Again, this problem does not present from the main feed (meaning the video is not actually trimmed) but only noticeable when the reel is viewed in fullscreen mode. Please fix this so the content can be viewed as it was intended to be viewed.

On another note, there should really be a paste from clipboard option on mobile so that users can quickly upload a photo copied from their camera roll without having to find it a second time from instagram’s end. If the user already has hold of a particular photo, why search for it a second time? Why not just paste and be good to go? This should work for multiple slide posts as well. Less jumping around or having to make temporary albums just for the importing process. Please consider these suggested changes and thanks for reading.

reviews.author: jellybeanezintheaire
reviews.title: New to Internet & Instagram
reviews.body: I am a product of the ‘60s, very familiar with phone usage, but still learning how this “iphone”and all its apps., & “collection of information” operates,(in the day of “landlines” & “party lines”, this was considered eavesdropping or wiretapping). But having nothing to hide & hiding nothing, I will try to move into the 21st century, while trying not to think of this “phone”as a tool for “Big Brother”. Anyway, since this is handy to keep in touch with family, that is busy and has only spare minutes to communicate, I will get in line with the rest of the #s. I have only one comment(maybe two); the collection of information of “our investigations”, say on Google for instance, or Wikipedia, or a medical source, does not necessarily reflect our own health. It truly can be curiosity, or an intellectual search to increase knowledge, much like “going to the library”. By trying to tie all researches into one picture you are making a one-dimensional assumption. Even for ads/sale/promos, you call “cookies”, do you remember Pinterest? “Wishbook” daydreaming ! The “iPhone” practicality WAS good as an extension of being part of the community wherever we may be, but it’s becoming weary with all the 🔍🗿intrusive stipulations and assumptions. Truthfully, I feel like I am training a robot just to use the text with all of it’s challenges and having to correct “her/Siri “. You’ve heard my “computer-illiterate “ review, and I’m going back to writing ✍️ letters! Thank you for asking!

reviews.author: concerning_confetti
reviews.title: The algorithm is upsetting
reviews.body: Hi instagram! I enjoy your app with reels and such, but there are many aspects that make me want to bring my time and hard work to other apps. I am an artist, and I’m sure someone working at instagram by now has noticed how upset artists are with hashtags and how the algorithm works. We want a change so that us small artists can actually reach new followers. So far, the only way to do that is by using one audio that, by this point, everyone despises. Hashtags do not work to reach new people, and my feed doesn’t post from everyone I’m following. It chooses the same exact people to show me, and every once in awhile switches a few of them. Sometimes I refresh my feed, and it doesn’t even show me anything new. I’ve been on this platform for a long time now, and I can’t get my art out there no matter what I’m doing ! The same goes for so many amazingly talented artists, who all deserve the art to be seen. I understand that everyone wants clout and attention on this app, I also understand you can’t meet everyone’s demands all the time. We just ask that we can get a chance. At least, a chance at other people looking at our art depending on things such as hashtags. I have one reel awhile back that blew up, but it wasn’t even that good of a reel. The drawings were poor and only quickly sketched as a joke for the audio. The only reason that reel blew up was BECAUSE of the audio, and not the content. I have run across thousands of upset artists at this point, who are simply doing everything to appease the algorithm, and to no avail. I hope you take this into consideration, because at this point, you’re going to start losing people to other apps.

reviews.author: myguardiandear5
reviews.title: Subscription Issue
reviews.body: When I first heard about the Instagram subscriptions and the testing phase here in the US, I was literally jumping up and down on my seat with joy and excitement. My heart was pounding crazy. You can imagine how unreal and surreal that official invite email from Instagram seemed to me one October morning. I simply could not believe that I was chosen to try subscriptions out of many other talented creators and immediately started planning and working because my account is actually perfect for subscriptions, for I upload flash cards with English expressions on them for Korean speakers. I could make videos to provide my subscribers with more in-depth explanations for each post, I happily thought. On December 1st, I finally published my subscriptions that I’ve so much looked forward to, planned, and prepared; only to realize that my followers in South Korea, which is where majority of my followers are located, don’t even see the subscription button on my main profile page. Half of me died that moment. I spoke with help center a few times, but all they could say was, sorry, subscription is currently not working in South Korea. Subscriptions can be purchased in almost every country, except the five countries on the blacklist, according to the official Instagram statement, and of course, South Korea is definitely not one of them. I am grateful that they chose my account to have this privilege, but they should fix this bug before they invite more people and cause more confusion and heartbreaks.

reviews.author: Wattpadanian
reviews.title: Too many bugs for its popularity
reviews.body:
I run an informational account so I try to post as much as I can. I have an old phone, maybe 3 or 4 years, but every other app works fine. Not instagram. About half of my posts, I am unable to post. It stays at the top of my screen with a message “unable to post. Try again later” with a reload button and an x button next to it. Occasionally I am able to end up posting the original, but most of the time I have to re-caption and post it again. No matter what I do, I am unable to change the outcome - whether I turn off my WiFi or keep it on. Either it will end up posting on its own or it will just stay up there until I delete it. 
With this problem, I am unable to see what I’ve posted or the caption and I am unable to save it to post it later - either I completely delete it or I hope that it might load eventually. 
If I log onto another phone, it does not show that I am trying to post these images. It also does not show that I have any saved posts that I am ready to post - it just disregards all of the work I have already put into my account. 
For such a popular app, I would expect this process to be much easier. I should be able to see what I posted if it isn’t able to post and I should be able to decide I want to post them later if they aren’t posting. I should also be able to see posts I have created but yet to post, given that they are saved through my Instagram account and not through my phone. 
These bugs honestly make me consider that it’s not worth using the app.

reviews.author: bw1226
reviews.title: Algorithm, stories, and login/security need some work
reviews.body:
I’ve been on insta for quite a while, but I’ve noticed that some of the features (noticeably the ones that are also shared, or should I say dominated by other apps) need improvement.
1) Close friends stories. Why can I only have one? If the goal was to implement similar features to sn*pchat, then why can’t I have multiple close friends for different friend groups/family/business partners? It’s been years since this feature has been available on other apps and Meta has made no effort to improve upon it, opting instead for location mapping (which most don’t use due to larger following or public accounts) and Instagram notes (attention seeking).
2) Login/security. Why can I not connect my iCloud account to Meta and use it to log in? From anecdotes, many of my friends have had their instagrams hacked, but it seems like iCloud is generally harder for scammers to access…additionally, getting locked out of my Instagram accounts has happened to me more than once. Meta should consider implementing this feature like other social media apps have.
3) finally, the algorithm isn’t as good as other social media apps. Understandably some, including myself, may be concerned about the lack of privacy and the information Meta is obtaining. However, given how much information is already available to them upon making an account, I would expect higher quality content on reels and suggested posts than what I am currently seeing.
More than willing to adjust my review should I see these features implemented.

reviews.title: I keep getting banned for no reason.
reviews.body:
Ok so basically i had a account and it got banned i appealed from it and i waited 2-3 days and tried to log back mind you i dont even know what i did i woke up and i was banned so when i logged back in after appealing they told me my account was permanently banned and said for “Child pornography “ so my first response was 🤨 first of all im not a child. I am a grown adult. secondly I never once sent or posted any nude pictures of myself or anyone else. so i moved on from that account which was kinda hard due to the fact i built that account for about 7 months and was at 1.4k but whatever i moved on so i had another account after that i had this account for about a month i got off the app to go do something on messenger i sent a message then it kicks me off saying i’ve been banned i go to look at my instagram because i don’t even post at all on facebook  so it was no way i got banned on there. So i went to instagram and i was banned again for “Child pornography” 
and i was really confused because i barely posted that day and i don’t have that bad of memory to just forget. i tried to make 2 other accounts to start another one because im getting banned for no reason at all. Both accounts got banned. one for them as soon as i made it and one of them about 15 minutes after i made it. Honestly im really just confused at this point. I tried reaching out though im not hearing back from nobody.

reviews.title: Instagram plz fix this issue. Not only is it annoying but it’s also very very VERY frustrating!!!
reviews.body: I started using this app about several years ago and back then everything worked perfectly, but in these last couple of years, it has been hard to defend this app. There are some major major flaws, and it’s starting to get frustrating. Instagram used to be my #1 favorite app and I’d easily give it a 5 star rating and would recommend it to anyone who didn’t already have it, but now with all these tech issues, it’s hard to recommend it to people who are interested in getting it. For example, Instagram will randomly just crash sometimes and you won’t be able to receive or send any DMs, you can’t refresh your feed, if you try to log out and log back in, then you get the error message and there are a couple of other things as well. Instagram needs to figure this stuff out and fix it because it gets even more frustrating with each day that passes because you can’t see any DMs. This app used to be great and it ran so smoothly and flawlessly, but now it isn’t working as well as it used to. And, I also feel that Instagram is trying to add so many bells and whistles that it’s starting to turn into every other app that we use. I thought Instagram was supposed to be unique and fun in its own way, but I guess they want to be just another average app that everyone has on their phone. Instagram, please fix this issue that’s been happening for a long time now. It may not happen to everyone who has it, but for the people that it does happen to, you have to find a way to resolve it!!!

reviews.author: CD Family
reviews.body: It will not let you see the content you want. I have changed my algorithm 20 times and it absolutely will not show me art. I get cats and random people and stuff I'm not interested in. it's annoying. Even when you search "art" after you scroll once its back to stuff I don't want. I'm over it.

reviews.author: Shanna Wallace
reviews.body: if you send someone a link to a post now, it will have your profile attached to it, even if it wasn't your post. they get a popup with whatever account you were logged in to prompting them to follow it. instagram made this change without any notification. details of your profile should not be attached when you copy / paste a link to a post that wasn't even yours, especially when you have all options to make your account visible to contacts / searchable by email disabled.

reviews.author: Jasper Ransom
reviews.body: The video calling on this app is hardly worth using. Each time I've used it, the video quality gets super pixilated and grainy anytime the service isn't exactly *perfect*. The calls also take way too much battery power, quickly heat up the phone, and have overheated the phone before. Having video call functionality is great, but when it's so cumbersome and not worth using, what's the point?

reviews.author: Madison Walker
reviews.body: Every time I start using Instagram again I remember why I don't. Every single time I'm on reels and scrolling, eventually the videos will only play halfway and then don't play the rest of the video. It's not a connection issue and I've been dealing with this ever since reels came out. I don't want to watch half a video just for it to cut off.

reviews.author: Kyle Nichols
reviews.body: With the latest update, you can no longer be logged in to more than one account. I've seen no improvements with the last few updates other than the layout, which didn't need fixing, and the logo change. The app used to scroll through my feed smoother too, a thing of the past. It used to work well, but now I might just uninstall it since I have to log in every time anyway. Might as well save the space on my phone for an app that works. Galaxy S5 update: it's now even worse.

reviews.author: Warren Abbott
reviews.body: They push a lot of silly stuff onto you, and the ads are often just slightly off. Like, yes, I'm interested in this, but not in the way the algorithm seems to think. Otherwise, it's nice to share personal photos and animal pics/vids with people I love. Yet, I find myself thinking of chucking the whole app almost daily. Then again, I often think of disappearing into the wilds, so that just might be the way I'm wired. 🤷🏻‍♂️

reviews.author: Ryan Walker
reviews.body: Good hell, how are you pushing 2 ads for every 1-2 reels?? I click not interested, I've seen too many ads, irrelevant, inappropriate, blah blah blah but they just keep coming. Also, the new algorithm is ridiculous. Same problems, click not interested and get a related reel immediately after. I'm guessing meta doesn't recognize not interested as valid. Keep "improving" the app, it's so close to being trash👍

reviews.author: Aeiroki
reviews.body: this app can be very fun! using it for the first time since facebook bought it back in the day and it's ok. it needs more timeline options, i'd like it to keep my place when my screen turns off or i re-open the app (same problem i have with fb), or at least an option not to refresh, necessarily. it is easy to upload stuff. it runs only on an algorithm so you have to scroll to "friends" where it tells you it's caught up with- but i'm not, i just logged on and watched 2. fix? disable ai summary?

reviews.author: Hailey Parana
reviews.body: The ads for Threads is getting rediculous. It's made to look like instagram content to get you to click on it. I am not interested in threads no matter how many people I follow have it. That's their business not mine. Chill with all the ads not just Threads. I'm getting ads for things that make no sense, it seems like Instagram doesn't have a team of sorts to monitor which ads their putting out. Do ya'll really want to be associated with half of what you advertise?

reviews.author: Jeremy Armstrong
reviews.body: Every time someone sends me a DM, I get the notification for it, but when I open it the message immediately disappears. Vanish mode is turned off, and I've cleared casche/data several times. Every time it happens, I have to uninstall and reinstall the app in order for the message to reappear. Incredibly frustrating!

reviews.author: madison wright
reviews.body: App is absolutely awful on the Z Fold 8. Opening reels from friends will result in either a black screen, frozen video, or the video will zoom way out and I'm not able to interact with it at all (liking it, commenting, reposting, etc). This happens regardless of if I use the phone while folded or open. I'm constantly being shilled Instagram Premium which is insulting because nothing about the base app makes me think "wow! I want to spend money on this thing!".

reviews.author: Mena R
reviews.body: Stop your endless login loops, they don't work! I have been using this app for years. 3 years ago, I created a new account for my business and was using it until 2 weeks ago when all of a sudden it locked me out, and now has me in an endless login loop. My insta account is linked in Meta, I have tried all the options, reported the bug twice, tried selfie login, get friends help, EVERYTHING! Nothing works. Not a single code to my number or email. Nothing!!!

reviews.author: John Carmichael
reviews.body: I wish there was a different platform that my friends would look at to post photos on. It's frankly amazing how bad the photo and video editing workflows are; it is significantly easier to edit elsewhere to then finally post. The ads are plentiful, and only really relevant in terms of being vaguely related to your in-person conversations you swore Instagram was closed during. The algorithm was designed to be addictive, not to show your photos to your friends. 1/10 I consider deleting it daily.

reviews.author: IVEN_7
reviews.body: it worked well at first, not a horrible app to go watch reels on and text friends. but my account got suspended for no reason, something to do with the AI detection, I have no idea. and I did nothing but watch reels and chat, and now I am losing all my accounts, then the appeal to get it back wouldn't work, it's honestly stupid. i can't even make another account.

reviews.author: K Plan
reviews.body: EDIT: For as long as I've had this app on my Android, when adding a comment to a video, i can't actually see the text I'm typing. The window is too small, and the keyboard covers it too. So i have to write, hit the back button to see what I've typed, then maybe type some more, fix, type, back, fix, type, back.... ad infinitum...

reviews.author: Frankie Jenkins
reviews.body: Scrolling through people's posts is great. Requiring a photo/video is what sets it apart from Facebook. Between every 5-6 posts, there will be an ad disguised as a post. Not the end of the world, some ads are even entertaining. My issue now is the reels. Reels are my go to for doom-scrolling short videos. Ads appear in between every 5-6 reels. Still not the end of the world. However, recently ads will now occasionally play at the end of a reel, ruining my experience if I wanted to watch it again

reviews.author: Aiden Herrera
reviews.body: it's just super enjoyable. the platforms also very fun. I'm pretty fond of it cuz I can make videos and I get a lot of views a decent amount and I'm doing pretty well for a starter overall the thing is just like very fun to use. everybody should use it. it's not really no reason not to unless you just don't like foams. it's pretty fun. if you want to use it you can. I highly recommend it 🙃

reviews.author: Tiffany Han
reviews.body: the reel transitions sometimes (not always) ruin reels bc they get stuck/temporarily pause the video instead of offering a smooth transition. a few reels have been ruined this way and you have to start over after posting. stories not always available to add to highlights sometimes until many days later. some earlier stories don't appear even though more recent ones do. don't understand why.

reviews.author: Akemi
reviews.body: My app is so laggy and glitchy. Almost every time I open it, nothing will load. I can send a message and it won't even send it, and I could be sitting right in my house with the Wi-Fi on. Not to mention how the UI is absolutely horrible with these glitches. Every button squishes, or my story is stuck to the top of my phone and not the full screen? I could type something on my story, and the text gets squished down so it's all in one line. Idk if it's just me, but it is getting highly annoying.

reviews.author: ZANE Duncan
reviews.body: this new update is awful, I can't even post a 2 minute reel, a message will pop up saying "cannot combine clips right, try again later" even though I had only selected one clip, and reels are low resolution and will stop playing randomly like the video has to buffer, on top of this it will say that someone's online when they very well aren't while I'm messaging them/just sent a message.

reviews.author: Matthew Alexander
reviews.body: Glitchy, won't send me a password recovery, and shows nothing but ads for several days every two weeks. I show coworkers when it happens: every couple of weeks, i'll open the app, will see very few pages i actually follow, and every other post will be an add. this is exactly why i stopped using facebook, and it's gotten so bad in the last few weeks that i've basically stopped using the app.

reviews.author: Abby Crews
reviews.body: my account got disabled. can't recover it. can't create new account, it gets auto blocked. can't talk to a real person about the issue, bc you need to be logged into an account for that. garbage user interface design, guess i won't use it! no idea why i was blocked in the first place. i had like 13 followers and only ever posted pics of my pets and drawings.

reviews.author: Micah Dunn
reviews.body: Me and my friend had a AI generated background and we wanted to change it to something we both liked so I got rid of it to change it to customize it but it is changed to where you can't do that anymore but you also can add a picture from your gallery as a background. please make it to where we can pick a picture from our gallery as our background on texts.

reviews.author: Jacob Paxton
reviews.body: The amount of ads on reels is absolutely annoying. Can't even go a few minutes without getting ads and there is always 2 ads in a row. At this point I am able to predict when there's going to be an ad almost everytime. I wish I could could give less than a one star Here's a update. TAKE THE ADS OFF OF REELS. They are so annoying and unnecessary to even be there in the first place. it is literally ad hell on the reels side of Instagram. They do not need to be there

reviews.author: Chris Smith
reviews.body: I uninstalled and reinstalled to try and fix a couple of annoying bugs. This was around a week ago. The app won't let me login to my account. It say my password is incorrect (it's not). Then, it sends a code to my phone just to give me an error. I try a code to my email, a blank error message. I've tried so many solutions, nothing. I can login on my phone's internet app and google chrome btw, so it's the Instagram app that's the issue. I still can't login on this app after 3 weeks...

reviews.author: Ezio Ahmet
reviews.body: I haven't been able to open my settings for nearly a month! I've cleared data, uninstalled the app, changed to professional back to personal, and nothing works. Fix this issue! I would like to be able to change my settings from the app in my phone edit: it's been 2 months now Edit 3: still can't access them on the app after nearly 3 months! and multiple updates!

reviews.author: Megan
reviews.body: Finally, I can pause reels! however there's still one major problem that needs to be fixed which is the fact that when I'm watching reels Instagram forces my phone to go into silent mode. It doesn't actually put my phone into silent mode but all my notifications are silent as if it was and I don't understand how this kind of overreach is okay. You have absolutely NO right to decide for me that I should not be listening to my notifications especially when I have medication reminders!!

reviews.author: C Green
reviews.body: I have been fully logging out & removing the profile when not in use to protect privacy. Activity in other apps with completely unaffiliated email addresses, no shared number, etc. was still used within this app, even with every available setting that would allow sharing or gleaning of information turned off. I deleted the app & restarted phone. Days later, I downloaded it again. When I opened it, my profiles were pre-populated and logged in without entering a password.

reviews.author: Trey (T-R3Y)
reviews.body: the ig app is unusable on my new phone. Every other app works as it should, but ig won't even open. I've tried every troubleshooting suggestion: uninstall/reinstall, clearing cache, clearing data, downloading the latest updates for my ui and the app. Every time I try to use ig, it says, "Logging you in..." but nothing ever happens. It just stays on that loading screen. It's very annoying!

reviews.author: Forest
reviews.body: The fall off of Instagram needs to be studied. From things like photos and videos not working when trying to upload, constantly battling with having to repost story or page posts over and over until they finally load and stay on my page (otherwise they disappear). DMs don't send me notifications half the time, or it hides messages in my inbox until I refresh the page 5 times and then they load in. All of those aside the algorithm has slowly gotten worse, but atp the app is almost unusable.

reviews.author: Rori Ferguson
reviews.body: I use instagram literally all the time. But it's getting to a point where I might stop. There's a glitch that keeps occurring where it says on my profile that im an "ai creator" when no where on my account have I used ai or said that I have. I've tried everything to get it to stop saying that, but everytime I refresh it just comes back. I'm honestly at a loss. I really don't have much hope left for Instagram anymore.

reviews.author: Roger McCoy
reviews.body: Used to be good, but lost itself somewhere. Hides the profiles of people I'm following under waves of "suggested content." Settings to override this automatically turn off after a month. The program is making questionable additions to encourage AI-generated content made based on other people's photos. Clicking on post notifications often takes me to a different post than the one I'm being notified for.

reviews.author: Lovish Delirious
reviews.body: Not sure what's happening, but recently this app has been freezing and becoming unresponsive A LOT. My WiFi never changed, I also still have high speed data and I've closed other apps while running this one. Still having the same issue. No other app has been doing this so it can't be my phone. When the app is working, everything is great, so 3 stars for now...

reviews.author: Claude Arja
reviews.body: Absolutely trash, used to love it, best version was 421.0.0.51.66, it's as if they're using ai to update the app, it started crashing out of nowhere, updated it, didn't work, I can only open it for 5 seconds before it lags & crashes & the update is worse, instead of fixing bugs and issues they just add more useless options, researched for what I could do to fix said crash, tried everything, app didn't cooperate, and the help centre is useless as well, miss when there was actual people developing

reviews.author: Natalie Rowena Lilith Spurr
reviews.body: It's ok. I don't go on it often, but recently I have noticed that a lot of reels/vids etc I see now are full of violence, animal abuse, theft etc. Things I've never actively looked for, but suddenly are all there, usually the algorithm will suggest it if you have, but I haven't. I'm going to permanently delete it soon. I really don't get the hipe!

reviews.author: Paula Goodale
reviews.body: As with other meta apps it's increasingly difficult to see content from friends and ordinary people rather than businesses. In addition, I wish they would allow you to set video content not to play by default. The constant motion makes me queasy, and I'm mainly there for the photos anyway. I find video much less engaging, and mostly pretty banal, and when I'm bombarded with it, I have to quit the app. Also need to be able to mute the sound on stories by default.

reviews.author: Sammie
reviews.body: It was working wonderfully for a couple of months, but now all of a sudden I can't view my fyp? I can't scroll, like, share, forward, add a note, nothing. I can only hit my back button on my phone for it to get off a frozen looking screen. I can only text now. Please fix this! I even deleted some apps for extra space if that was the case.

reviews.author: NATE
reviews.body: As much as I love Instagram's messaging, there are way too many bugs. It takes a few minutes for each message to send, and I have to refresh the DM page over and over to get updates. My messages have even sent hours later. I originally thought it was a problem with my internet but I have very smooth and fast internet, no other app or game gives me any problems. I also get updates extremely late, or have to reinstall the app to get these bug fixes.

reviews.author: seth evermore
reviews.body: More customization like banners. I still don't have the edit grid thing and it makes me so mad. The app itself is not bad, but I wish there was an actual option to turn off the suggested for you accounts because it's annoying. And even if I turn it off using the button next to the shared profile, it reappears. Oh yea, whenever I open my profile, it would show old contents like deleted highlights. The refresh button ain't enough, just don't show it at all.

reviews.author: Sam Slutzky
reviews.body: I can only imagine that Meta is actively trying to make the app worse. Now, when I click to see "more", there is a useless pop up window instead of just showing the text in place. This makes the text about ten times harder to read, since it's small and quickly scrolls out of view. I can't image a single user found this to be a better experience.

reviews.author: Dino Bettini
reviews.body: Worse with each passing day. It is so full of bugs that I have a feeling only interns work on it. E.g. the Mixed format is extremely bugged, stretching all horizontal images in the feed but appearing correctly on the profile. EDIT: Now broken on profile as well. Every post has been destroyed retroactively. Just hope it's not intended, but nothing would surprise me at this point. Not to mention the reels pushed down your throat constantly, and barely seeing posts from accounts you follow.

reviews.author: Madison McNulty
reviews.body: Moderately Fun, if not Slightly Invasive. The app is an alright place to see posts made by friends, but it's basically an Ad focused marketplace. There's pretty much only social media marketing here and a few small businesses, and it's lost its original intention of being a photo sharing app. The customer service is also pretty much not there at all and there is no moderation of comments, so it's become a hot bed for the worst possible responses on social media to exist so much so its a joke.

reviews.author: Lady Dy
reviews.body: update: three days ago my account was totally fine. 2 days ago I tried posting about snack food and energy drinks and I have been flagged for violating community standards. now I cannot post or edit any of my pictures. I can still like and comment but nothing else and I have had no help from customer support. I been using the app since it first came out. Loved it then, love it now. It's easy to use. It's a great way to share photos and short videos.

reviews.author: Myleah L.
reviews.body: Can't remove tags or add collaborators without getting an error that says "couldn't save edits, try again later" more and more bugs continue to pop up making this app buggy and difficult to use. unnecessary AI implementation when other things still don't work. a feed that is completely out of order and never shows me half of the posts of people I follow.

reviews.author: Bhumi Vora
reviews.body: The friends requests which I recieve have now piled up to 70+ but I can can't check for more than 10 requests at a time, because further it keeps buffering... This is happening for months now This app might be a very good app for social connections, but the bugs are increasing slowly. Now, it keeps showing notifications of the accounts that have been deleted!! I don't know if I can have a substitute of instagram, but THIS should not continue.

reviews.author: Richard Beck-Boudreaux
reviews.body: Instagram has become unrecognizable from what it once was. I login today and 9 out of every 10 posts are ads (recommendations for pages I'm not following and random video reels are considered ads). I find it incredibly difficult to tailor my experience to actually seeing posts from friends, or anything I'm actually interested in. it's like the Internet in the 90's without ad blockers. this is just really such a terrible awful social network that does not function as a social network anymore.

reviews.author: Zachary Conrad
reviews.body: I've turned on notifications for several pages, but I never get notified (not even when I open the app). I've verified that notifications are on in my system settings. It's super annoying because a lot of college clubs only post events on Instagram, so if I don't check regularly I miss events. Fix the notifications!

reviews.author: anna
reviews.body: this is a good app, but unfortunately i didnt get the feature where u can put a song on ur profile. i did get it once, but suddenly the feature dissapeared. but when someone views my account, they can still see what song i put on my profile! ive tried updating but it doesnt work. (my another account still has the feature tho, its just my main that didnt).

reviews.author: Emilio Martinez
reviews.body: Disappointed. The application doesn't load the settings on my profile page, I have to scroll down then up for it to appear. Whenever I call I'm unable to send reels as it just says "Nothing to show". The photos I received from others don't load and I have to reopen the app like 3 times for it to work.

reviews.author: Tash Thumwood
reviews.body: My last review was negative and this one remains negative. I'm glad we can upload more than 1 photo again now however nothing loads!!! The filters never load, it's a struggle getting music to load to add. So many bugs and glitches!!! Fix this app please!!!! It seems the creators only care about what they are making from professionals and not fixing anything!!!
